title: POUCH INVADER
subtitle: THE LAYTENANT
tagline: Rent-free. No lease. Too late to ask questions.
description: A friend's comedy submission dedicated to Lay — a cat that claims the kangaroo's pouch without a lease, and a kangaroo that never signed up for this. Cute, absurd, and rent-free.

back_story:
For Lay — who knows a squatter when he sees one.

Nobody knows when the cat moved in. The kangaroo just woke up one morning, felt a little heavier... and heard a purr. Rent-free. No lease. And honestly? It's too late to ask questions.

The cat, for its part, has never acknowledged the arrangement. It doesn't pay rent, it doesn't sign contracts, and it absolutely does not move out. The kangaroo has tried everything: hopping, sighing, looking dramatically into the distance. The cat remains unbothered.

Some say the pouch was always the cat's. The kangaroo was just the landlord who never got the memo.

curation.en: A comedy card from friend Lay — the cat claims the pouch; the kangaroo never signed up. Subtitle pun: The Laytenant = lieutenant + tenant + Lay.
